sections.name: elev
sections.note: mean land elevation of the cell; open ocean = 0 (sea surface)

landfrac.note: fraction of MAP cells (cells.bin.gz) inside the SIM cell: land = id >= 2, lake = id 1

source.name: WorldClim version 2.1, 10 arc-minute monthly tavg / prec / elev
source.citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology 37 (12): 4302–4315.
source.terms: See data/sources/climate.md: worldclim.org states free academic / non-commercial use; redistribution or commercial use requires prior permission.

processing.maskedPixels: 1471 WorldClim pixels with tavg exactly 0.0 °C in all 12 months (zero-filled gaps) and 1087 polar halo pixels around them (warmest month < 3 °C, annual range below 3 °C at 55°, 5 °C at 60°, 7 °C at 65°, 10 °C at 70°, 15 °C at 75°, 18 °C at 80°) ignored for every variable
processing.oceanFill: screened Poisson fill from coasts towards a zonal/seasonal sea-surface air formula with current anomalies; influence length T 3.5 cells, P 5 cells; second temperature pass over frozen seas (ice weight 0..1 for pass-1 T -1..-7 °C): target = min(formula, 25-cell coast extension); enclosed water bodies < 600 cells: Laplace fill from shores
processing.antarctic: land cells south of 60°S above 1000 m blended (weight smoothstep((z-1000)/1500)) towards Fortuin & Oerlemans 1990 T = 34.46 - 0.00914 z - 0.688|lat| + South Pole seasonal cycle; accumulation towards (600 e^(-z/700) + 20)/12 mm/month; 21218 cells
